provenance.user_pack: Three 18650 cells in series, declared 3.7 V and 3000 mAh each; manufacturer unknown
provenance.surrogate_cell: Molicel INR-18650-P30B, datasheet v1.0: typical 3 Ah, DC impedance 17 mOhm at 50% SOC, 4.2 V charge, 2.5 V discharge, nominal 3.6 V
provenance.ocv_curve: Generic monotone engineering approximation; NOT measured OCV and NOT digitized from the datasheet discharge graphs
provenance.electronics_load: 5 W constant pack-side budget for all electronics/converters; scenario assumption, NOT a measured Terasic consumption
provenance.resistance: Constant cell DC resistance surrogate; excludes unmeasured BMS, wiring and holder resistance, temperature and ageing
provenance.cutoff: Simulation cutoff from surrogate datasheet; NOT identified real pack BMS threshold
provenance.motor_current: Ideal effective output-shaft circuit inferred from existing torque-per-volt and joint damping; all viscous damping provisionally assigned to electrical braking. No added back-EMF torque
provenance.driver: Ideal average PWM bridge, no additional conversion losses, regenerative battery charging disabled; negative bridge power is dissipated
provenance.thermal_model: Fixed reference conditions; no thermal or RC polarization states
